title: 🕹️ gamebox — Apple-native Win32 game runtime
summary: Run unmodified Win32 PE games natively on macOS / Apple Silicon via a hexa-only stack — PE loader + Win32 API shim + DirectX→Metal — WITHOUT Wine (Wine 0), under a strict own1 posture (no DRM / Warden / anti-cheat bypass, no anima clone).

children.name: ℹ️ sprint composition
children.detail: Sprint meta-domain (`+` = composition) over the two near-ready titles + their shared prerequisites (LOADER · WIN32 · GFX · NET; D2R also BNET; Classic download PURPLE deferred).

children.name: ℹ️ DONE bar
children.detail: DONE = both titles flipped to playable in their own domains.

children.name: ℹ️ online play gate
children.detail: BOTH are ONLINE games — 'playable' needs a live server connection, gated by kernel anti-cheat (D2R=Warden · Classic=GameGuard); the honest-freeze on those kernel-AC layers is the hard wall for full online play.

children.name: 🎮 게임 — per-game
children.detail: Eleven per-game bring-up domains. Each stands on the 메인구조 subsystems (+ its launcher); SSOT per title = .roadmap.<game> + .checkpoint.<x>. Online titles are gated by kernel anti-cheat honest-freeze where blocked.
